items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence shows only that no certificate is reported expiring within 30 days. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases; continue only existing read-only evidence work and ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. This is not penetration testing, certification, or a clean bill of health.

Continue the existing read-only fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue work, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
